guide.h2: Why the waste carrier licence matters
p: If your rubbish is fly tipped, you can be fined, even if you paid someone to take it. Anyone who carries waste for money must be registered as a waste carrier with the Environment Agency. Ask for the registration number and check it on the Environment Agency public register before they load anything, and keep the receipt or waste transfer note.

faqs.q: Do I need to check a rubbish removal firm's licence?
faqs.a: Yes. If your waste is fly tipped you can be held responsible. Check the waste carrier registration on the Environment Agency register before they take anything.

faqs.q: Is rubbish removal cheaper than a skip?
faqs.a: For a single load or when you have no space for a skip, often yes. For a big renovation where you fill it over several days, a skip is usually cheaper.

faqs.q: Does Leeds City Council collect bulky items?
faqs.a: Yes. Leeds residents get one free unwanted items collection of up to 5 items each financial year, and up to 3 more at £30 each. Book online.

faqs.q: Can rubbish removal firms take garden waste?
faqs.a: Yes, most will take green waste, soil and old garden furniture. Heavy soil and rubble may cost more.
